mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current prices returns the latest NADAC per unit for each package (NDC) of a drug. Price changes returns week-over-week moves with the old price, new price, percent change and CMS's stated reason - the flagship view. Price history returns the weekly series for one year.

drugName.title: Drug name contains
drugName.description: Brand or generic name ("ozempic", "atorvastatin", "insulin"). Partial match against the NADAC label, which looks like "ATORVASTATIN 20 MG TABLET". Add a strength to narrow it.

ndc.title: NDC code
ndc.description: Exact 11-digit National Drug Code for one specific package, if you already know it. Optional.

drugType.title: Generic or brand
drugType.description: Limit to generic or brand-name products. NADAC classifies every entry as one or the other.

year.title: Year
year.description: Which NADAC year to read, for current prices and price history. Ignored in price-changes mode, which spans all years.

sinceDays.title: Changes in the last N days
sinceDays.description: Price-changes mode only. How far back to look for price moves. NADAC republishes weekly, so 30 days covers about four updates.

minPercentChange.title: Minimum percent change
minPercentChange.description: Price-changes mode only. Only return moves of at least this size, up or down. 0 returns every change. Use 10 or 25 to surface the ones worth acting on.

newOnly.title: Only new price changes
newOnly.description: Price-changes mode only. Remembers what earlier runs already returned and reports only changes it has not seen before, so a scheduled run becomes a price-move alert.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Maximum rows to return. In price-changes mode the biggest moves are returned first.
